deep_dives.what_happened: The U.S. Navy completed a 1,000 nautical mile transit with the service’s Orca XLUUV uncrewed submarine in July, a first for the service. deep_dives.title: Pentagon inks deals with Boeing, RTX to boost production of SM-3 components
deep_dives.what_happened: The Pentagon signed seven-year framework agreements Friday with Boeing and RTX to expand production of critical components for the Standard Missile-3.

deep_dives.title: America is sailing through the Taiwan Strait less. Does it matter?
deep_dives.what_happened: A Heritage Foundation study shows a significant drop in Taiwan Strait transits by the US military under the second Trump administration.

deep_dives.title: Patriot makers hedge on Ukraine production deal as officials question cause of hold-up
deep_dives.what_happened: Though Trump promised Kyiv a license to build Patriot missile interceptors last month, Lockheed Martin and Raytheon have put the brakes on production.
